fields.name: SqlParameterCollectionExtensions scalar SQL parameter mapping
fields.description: The scalar parameter shape emitted by SqlParameterCollectionExtensions; its members state the variation dimensions shared by the input and output helper family.

members.name: parameterName
members.description: SQL Server parameter name, normalized to begin with @.

members.name: direction
members.description: Whether the parameter supplies or receives a query-contract value.

members.name: value
members.description: Input value; absent for output parameters and represented as database null for the nullable cases supported by the family.

members.name: size
members.description: Declared character or binary size for NVarChar, NChar, VarChar, Char, VarBinary, and Binary.

members.name: localeId
members.description: ANSI locale for VarChar and Char.

representations.csharp: SqlParameter with SqlDbType, ParameterDirection, Value, and the applicable size, LocaleId, Precision, or Scale.
